RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, February 24, 2010/Phalguna 5, 1931 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Road Transport and Highways; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
7
Police-Public ratio in country
*21. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA:  Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS  be pleased to state:
(a) the total sanctioned strength and
vacancies in all branches of police, rank-
wise and State-wise;
(b) the police-public Ratio (Policemen
per 1000 people) in the country, State-
wise; and
(c) how does it compare with Western
and Asian countries and what is the United
Nations’ norm?
Proposal to convert police complaints
into FIRs
*22. SHRI MOHD. ALI KHAN:  Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether his Ministry is considering
a proposal to convert all police complaints
into FIRs;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the reasons therefor?
Foreign currency earned from export
of handicrafts
†*23. SHRI BRIJLAL KHABRI: Will
the Minister of  TAXTILES be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that export of
handicrafts has increased during the current
year;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the amount of foreign currency
earned by export of handicrafts during this
period; and
(d) the names of countries to which
handicrafts were exported?
Links of terror connnected with
neighbouring countries
†*24. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
HOME AFFAIRS  be pleased to state:
(a)  whether Government is aware that
links of terror are connected with
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

8
neighbouring countries and their
Governments give patronage to them;
(b) whether illegal arms and fake
currencies are being trafficked from the
Middle East, Bangladesh and now even
from Nepal, and the centres of anti-India
activities have been established in these
countries;
(c) the efforts made by those
Governments so far to hand over the
declared terrorist conspirators living in
these countries to India; and
(d) the reasons for disappointing results
of these efforts?
Creation of separate Telangana
State
*25. SHRI SABIR ALI: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS  be pleased
to state:
(a) what were the circumstances which
necessitated unilateral decision favouring
creation of a separate Telangana State;
(b) whether it is a fact that such a
decision has encouraged others to demand
creation of separate States;
(c) if so, how the Government proposes
to deal with the situation; and
(d) whether Government proposes to
constitute a States Reorganization
Commission to consider these demands and
make recommendation thereon?
 Impact of Indo-Thai FTA
*26. SHRI RAHUL BAJAJ: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY  be pleased to state:
(a) what has been the impact of the Indo-
Thai Free Trade Agreement (FTA) on the
Indian Auto industry; and
(b) which Japanese companies are
sourcing which vehicles for our domestic
market from Thailand?
Indian citizenship for those who fled
from Afghanistan
*27. SARDAR TARLOCHAN
SINGH: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS  be pleased to state:
(a)  the number of persons who fled
from Afghanistan because of unrest and
have been given Indian Citizenship during
the last three years;
(b) the number of applications pending
and how long it will take to decide them;
and
(c) whether Government would adopt
a humanitarian policy to grant citizenship
to all of them?
Communal Violence Bill
*28. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS  be pleased to state:
(a)  whether it is a fact that the
Communal Violence (Prevention, Control
and Rehabilitation of Victims) Bill is still
pending in the Parliament;
(b) if so, the reasons for pendency of
the Bill; and
(c) by when the Bill is likely to be got
passed?
Shortage of IPS officers
*29. SHRI MOINUL HASSAN: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there is acute shortage of
IPS officers in police forces;

9
(b) what is the ratio of population to
IPS officers and the comparative figures of
police officers and the population in
neighbouring countries; and
(c) when did Government realise the
shortage of IPS officers to deal with the
increasing problem of law and order in the
country?
Purpose of Malabar exercises
*30. SHRI TIRUCHI SIV A: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) what is the purpose of Malabar
exercises;
(b) whether one of the purposes of such
exercises is to test inter-operability of
forces; and
(c) whether Indian Defence doctrine
provides for such bilateral inter-operability?
Blacklisting  of  companies  from
supplying defence equipments
*31. SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL: W ill the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether his Ministry has in the past
banned or blacklisted companies from
supplying defence equipment if implicated
in corruption cases internationally;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is a fact that M/s BAE
Systems has been implicated by British
Government and the US Government and
whether Government would blacklist this
company; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Steps to prevent recurrence of
terrorist attacks
†*32. SHRI GOVINDRAO
W AMANRAO ADIK: Will the Minister
of HOME AFFAIRS  be pleased to state:
(a)  the steps taken by Government so
far in order to prevent recurrence of
Mumbai type terrorist attack; and
(b) the steps being taken by
Government to strengthen the intelligence
network?
Shifting of shooting range from the
vicinity of Kargil town
*33. PROF. SAIF-UD-DIN SOZ:  Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Ministry had received
proposals from the people of Kargil for
shifting of armed forces’ shooting range from
the vicinity of the town to a distant place;
and
(b) if so, the action taken thereon?
Criteria for selecting Padma awardees
*34. SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRA-
SEKHAR: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS  be pleased to state:
(a) the criteria adopted and the
procedure followed for selecting this year's
Padma awardees;
(b) the names of the Members of the
Committee which finally decided these
awardees; and
(c) whether there are any rules/
guidelines prohibiting MPs from being
considered for these awards and, if so, since
when this rule/guideline has been in
operation?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

10
Cross-border infiltration through
LOC
*35. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of  HOME AFFAIRS  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that BSF found
border fence on Indo-Pak border cut at
many places;
(b) if so, the details of such incidents in
2009-10 and number of infiltrators crossed
over to this side;
(c) the number and nationalities of illegal
infiltrators apprehended; and
(d) the steps taken to beef-up security?
MoU with China to strengthen
imports from India
*36. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA: W ill the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has recently
signed a MoU with China to strengthen
imports from India;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) to what extent the MoU is going to
ensure exports/imports in a healthy growing
atmosphere;
(d) whether several trade related
disputes with China are pending; and
(e) if so, the facts thereof?
Malabar class Naval exercises
*37. SHRI B.S. GNANADESIKAN:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) the number of Malabar class Naval
exercises taken place so far, year-wise and
location-wise details thereof;
(b) which countries participated in
these exercises;
(c) what is the purpose of these
exercises;
(d) whether Indian soldiers get to handle
the naval and strategic assets  of
participating navies; and
(e) if not, what is the agreed protocol
for such exercises?
Deaths due to occupational diseases
and accidents
*38. SHRI RAMA CHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of
LABOUR AND EMPLOYMENT  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has the correct
statistics about the number of deaths due
to occupational diseases and accidents, if
so, the details thereof,  State-wise and
industry-wise; and
(b) how many industries have been
punished for not maintaining the health and
safety standards in the projects?
Elevated ring road for Delhi
*39. SHRI PARVEZ HASHMI: Will
the Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT
AND HIGHWAYS   be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal for
building elevated ring road in National
Capital Territory of Delhi on Build-
Operate-Transfer(BOT) Basis or by Delhi
Government;
(b) if so, the total cost of project and
time of completion; and
(c) if not, the other proposed projects
to curb the heavy congestion of traffic on
the roads of Delhi?

11
Effect of FCRA on NGOs receiving
foreign funds
*40. SHRI VIJAY JAW AHARLAL
DARDA: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS  be pleased to state:
(a) the number of NGOs who received
foreign funds during 2005, 2006, 2007 and
2008;
(b) the quantum of foreign funds
received, year-wise;
(c) whether such NGOs are submitting
audited records as required under the
existing laws;
(d) if not, the nature of action taken to
ensure submission of audited records; and
(e) whether the Foreign Contributions
(Regulation) Bill introduced in the Rajya
Sabha during 2006 would result in
harassment and encourage corruption, as is
being apprehended by many NGOs?
N
EW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 18th February, 2010 Secretary-General.
Magha 29, 1931 (Saka)

I N D E X
(Ministry-wise)
Commerce and Industry : 26, 36,
Defence : 30, 31, 33, 37,
Home Affairs : 21, 22, 24, 25, 27, 28, 29, 32, 34, 35, 40,
Labour and Employment : 38,
Road Transport and Highways : 39,
Textiles : 23.
12
